title: What are geofences?
body:
What are geofences?

Geofences are safe places on the map for family members.

How it works:
1. A parent creates a zone (home, school, activities)
2. Sets address and radius
3. Gets notified when a child enters or leaves the zone

It's like a virtual fence around important places!
